title: psephellus hadimensis
intro: Psephellus hadimensis, commonly known as Hadimensis Dandelion, is a flowering plant species belonging to the sunflower family (Asteraceae). It has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health issues, including its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Psephellus hadimensis include relieving pain, reducing fever, and treating wounds. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
